A hands-on workshop on using [Containerlab](https://containerlab.dev) for networking labs. Work through the parts in
order. The lab files are in the workshop repository:
[github.com/aghufran/course](https://github.com/aghufran/course/tree/main/common/containerlab), in `common/containerlab`.

| Part | Topic | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Installing Containerlab | Available |
| 2 | Loading network OS images into Docker | Available |
| 3 | Writing a lab topology file | Available |
| 4 | Connecting to the nodes in a lab | Coming soon |
| 5 | Running a lab across several cloud VMs (AWS) | Coming soon |
